scenarios.title: Routine bounded work completes
scenarios.purpose: Prove the normal managed path from activation through evidence-based acceptance.
assertions: The exact context and dispatch are pinned.
Completion is accepted only after its Gate passes.

scenarios.title: Missing permission blocks dispatch
scenarios.purpose: Prove that authorization failure stops work before sensitive context or execution is issued.

scenarios.title: Material external action returns to the user
scenarios.purpose: Prove that irreversible effects cannot be authorized by the liaison or runner.
assertions: The user receives a decision request before dispatch.

scenarios.title: Parallel changes integrate together
scenarios.purpose: Prove that independent work may run together but must pass combined checks.

scenarios.title: Conflicting changes wait safely
scenarios.purpose: Prove that two writers cannot simultaneously own one conflict domain.
assertions: The other is deferred with an exact conflict reason.

scenarios.title: Interrupted reversible work is requeued
scenarios.purpose: Prove that an expired local attempt can retry within its attempt budget.

scenarios.title: Uncertain external effect is checked first
scenarios.purpose: Prove that an interrupted consequential action is not repeated blindly.
